name: Decentralized Euro
oneLiner: DEURO is a decentralized euro stablecoin minted from overcollateralized BTC, ETH, and crypto vaults using a Frankencoin-style oracle-free auction mechanism.
collateral: WFPS (Wrapped Frankencoin Pool Shares, about 63%), WBTC/cbBTC/kBTC (about 37%), plus DEPS, ZCHF, WETH/LsETH and tokenized equities, in oracle-free overcollateralized positions; WFPS/ZCHF/DEPS create cross-protocol Frankencoin-ecosystem and reflexive-governance exposure.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with automated liquidation; no oracle dependency (same architecture as Frankencoin ZCHF)

oracleRisk.summary: dEURO's permanent V2 and V3 MintingHub modules use permissionless challenge auctions instead of external price feeds. A V3 price reference can only be another valid same-collateral dEURO position and does not import an oracle provider.

branchApplicability.rationale: dEURO documents both permanent MintingHub generations as oracle-free. At finalized Ethereum block 25531509, PositionOpened logs covered 96 V2 and two V3 positions; direct reads found debt-bearing V2 positions across WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, kBTC, and WFPS, while both V3 positions had zero principal. Every position stores its owner-selected liquidation price and challenge period. V3's optional price reference must be a live, same-hub, same-collateral position with meaningful debt and only allows the cooldown on a price increase to be skipped; it is not an external oracle or provider fallback. Liquidation-price feed branches are therefore not applicable even though position-specific auction parameters remain material protocol risk.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: dEURO documents immutable Ethereum mainnet protocol contracts, while the tracked deployments extend to Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base. blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Polygon block 90293314, the tracked dEURO deployment's proxyOwner() returned verified MultiSigWalletWithDailyLimit 0x355b8E02e7F5301E6fac9b7cAc1D6D9c86C0343f. Its required() returned 1 and getOwners() returned one owner, SafeProxy 0x3a635c48836E7c0B9aEB378640B0BfD516985cF5; that Safe reported threshold 5 with 9 owners. The verified UChildERC20Proxy source gates updateImplementation and updateAndCall with onlyProxyOwner, so the 5-of-9 Safe can submit and confirm a proxy-upgrade transaction through the legacy wallet with no observed timelock. The current implementation has ordinary transfer paths, but this establishes an immediate upgrade-control ability to introduce holder restrictions on a tracked deployment.

mintAuthority.summary: DEURO is minted permissionlessly by users opening overcollateralized, oracle-free positions in Frankencoin-style minting modules. The DecentralizedEURO contract (0xba3f535bbcccca2a154b573ca6c5a49baae0a3ea) is immutable (no proxy, no owner). New minting modules require a challengeable application period; nDEPS (Equity) holders at 0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6 can veto proposals.

controls.label: Frankencoin-style minting module (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-position overcollateralization with oracle-free auction liquidation; users self-mint against approved collateral.
controls.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: the dEURO constructor block 22088283 approved 8 minting modules (MinterApplied events: 0x8b3c41c649b9c7085c171cbb82337889b3604618, 0x4ce0ab2fc21bd27a47a64f594fdf7654ea57dc79, 0x073493d73258c4beb6542e8dd3e1b2891c972303, 0x5c49c00f897bd970d964bfb8c3065ae65a180994, 0xd03cd3ea55e67bc61b78a0d70ee93018e2182dbe, 0x2353d16869f717bfcd22dabc0adbf4dca62c609f, 0x3ed40fa0e5c803e807ebd51355e388006f9e1fee, 0x0423f419de1c44151b6b000e2daa51859c1d5d2a); no MinterDenied events were observed through block 22,140,000, and isMinter() = true at the latest block for 0x8b3c41c6..., 0x4ce0ab2f... and 0x073493d7.... Mint is bounded per module by overcollateralized position rules; the module set is expandable through the application-and-veto process, so the aggregate cap is raiseable.

controls.label: nDEPS veto governance (Equity contract)
controls.evidence: nDEPS (Equity) at 0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6, deployed by the dEURO constructor in block 22088283, governs minting-module admissions: anyone may propose a module with a fee and application period; nDEPS holders can veto via denyMinter(). This governance path can authorize new minting capacity.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295200: DecentralizedEURO (0xba3f535bbcccca2a154b573ca6c5a49baae0a3ea) is immutable — no EIP-1967 proxy admin slot, owner() reverts, code length 21734. Equity/nDEPS contract (0xc71104001a3ccda1bef1177d765831bd1bfe8ee6) confirmed via internal CREATE from dEURO constructor at block 22088283. The minting model is Frankencoin-style: anyone can suggestMinter() with a fee and application period; nDEPS holders can denyMinter(). No privileged operator can mint directly; new modules are time-delayed and community-vetoable.

reserveReview.rationale: The current dEURO collateral positions capture contains four categories totaling 100%: WFPS, WBTC, cbBTC, and an aggregate Other collateral row. dEURO documentation describes immutable, oracle-free collateralized positions and the live API supplies the point-in-time weights; the aggregate residual remains explicitly unresolved rather than being split into unsupported constituents.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current dEURO collateral positions API and official protocol documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 0.5% Other collateral row is an aggregate live category whose constituent assets and issuer exposure are not disclosed by the reviewed API response.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The live API reports an aggregate Other collateral category without constituent identity or weights.
